subject.title: amazon-bedrock provider: Haiku 4.5 inference profile ARN not supported; params.modelId override ignored

question: Should Amazon Bedrock use `agents.defaults.models[...].params.modelId` as the AWS Converse `modelId`, or should the supported contract be selecting the inference profile id/ARN directly as the `amazon-bedrock/<model>` ref?
rationale: This changes provider/config semantics on a compatibility-sensitive model-routing path, and current code already has a separate profile discovery/ref model that may be the intended contract.

options.title: Keep Profile Refs Canonical
options.body: Document and repair direct `amazon-bedrock/<profile-id-or-ARN>` selection for Haiku 4.5 and region-pinned profiles, leaving `params.modelId` as non-identity metadata.

options.title: Add Bedrock Params Override
options.body: Implement `params.modelId` as a Bedrock-only request identity override with docs, compatibility tests, and live AWS proof.

options.title: Declare Override Unsupported
options.body: Close only the `params.modelId` part as unsupported after proving current profile refs work for the reporter's Haiku and regional profiles.

recommendation.title: Keep Profile Refs Canonical
recommendation.body: Document and repair direct `amazon-bedrock/<profile-id-or-ARN>` selection for Haiku 4.5 and region-pinned profiles, leaving `params.modelId` as non-identity metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice affects provider routing and config semantics beyond the original inference-profile implementation, and steipete has the strongest recent cross-boundary Bedrock/runtime history.
